newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Semiconductor rises on high profit.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Semiconductor rises on high profit.

text.p: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co rose sharply in late trade on Wednesday, reflecting investor bullishness after the company announced on Tuesday that its 1996 net profit grew 28.6 percent from a year ago, brokers said.
With 60 minutes left, Taiwan Semiconductor was up T$3 to T$61. Trade volume was a hectic 30.68 million shares.
Brokers said Taiwan Semiconductor, Taiwan's largest chipmaker, also was boosted by an expected recovery in Dynamic Random Access Memory chip prices.
"The fact that the company was able to do so well in 1996 despite the plunge in DRAM prices gave investors a lot of confidence for 1997," said George Hou, a fund manager for Jardine Fleming.
Taiwan Semiconductor posted a net profit of T$39.4 billion in 1996, compared to T$28.77 billion in 1995.
